source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Enter BMC Web UI and navigate to the Network protocol properties page.
2. Check text displayed and make sure it is readable.
3. Enable DDNS.
4. Under Method, choose Use domain name obtained from the DHCP server.
You may need to click on the DNS tab and enter in the IP of the DNS server.
5. Click Apply on the DDNS tab.
If it cannot connect to the domain server, it should show that it is unable to pull the domain name.
If it does not pull the domain name and it cannot connect to the server but does not show that it cannot pull the domain name, this is a defect.
6. After the domain name resolves, select the option to Use custom domain name.
7. Enter in the domain name to be sent to the server.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. DDNS information should be displayed correctly.
2. The domain name should resolve after step5

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" lan print 1 2>&1 | grep -iE "IP Address|MAC"; echo ---nslookup---; nslookup "$BMC_HOSTNAME" 8.8.8.8 2>&1 | head -10; echo ---lan-dns---; ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" lan print 1 2>&1 | grep -i dns
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return the BMC `lan print` DNS/IP lines plus an `nslookup` of the BMC hostname against a resolver, so the user confirms the DDNS domain name resolves after enabling.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: DDNS registration requires the BMC to reach a working dynamic-DNS server/DHCP-issued domain; Web UI enablement is operator-side, agent verifies the resulting resolution from a client.

original_test_intent: Visually verify DDNS WebUI configuration/readability and both DHCP-domain and custom-domain update paths, including an explicit unreachable-server error and successful resolution.
original_method: An engineer configures WebUI while DNS/provider queries and logs validate registration, error handling and cleanup.
manual_activity: WebUI readability, displayed DDNS state and error message are core engineer-observed criteria; the agent can run resolver/provider probes only.
safety_requirements: Use isolated authorized namespace and protected credentials.
Do not create public/unowned records or expose secrets.
Prevent stale/wrong-device records; no automatic retry.
Delete test records and restore prior settings.
agent_execution_scope: Query approved DNS/provider, correlate BMC identity and timestamps, and organize engineer WebUI evidence.
Do not claim UI/error observation or verdict.
engineer_actions: Configure/inspect WebUI paths and error message.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Public 8.8.8.8 lookup and IPMI read-back neither configure DDNS nor prove UI/error path; unsafe secrets rejected.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use provider-authoritative queries and secure credentials around the manual WebUI workflow.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: DHCP/custom paths, negative message, WebUI and 10/10 minutes remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Record prior state, test unreachable-provider message, configure DHCP-derived then custom name, verify authoritative registration/TTL/identity, capture WebUI and clean up.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact BMC DDNS client and controlled DNS zone.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform DDNS and provider update documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds authoritative record ownership, negative-path isolation and cleanup.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Preserves both UI paths and error handling.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Bad DDNS updates can redirect management names.

project_override_considerations: Project domains/providers are inputs; use test records only and report actual TTL/method.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently describes WebUI DDNS success and negative paths; missing provider data are inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The operation is clear and manually executable; visual UI/error acceptance makes it MANUAL ONLY.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Reclassifies PACKAGE to MANUAL ONLY due explicit UI/error acceptance.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Adds authoritative provider and cleanup evidence.

review_improvement: Proves the actual BMC registration, displayed error and record ownership rather than mere recursive resolution.
independent_technical_reasoning: A resolver answer cannot prove the WebUI displayed the configured method or the mandated failure message; those presentation facts require engineer observation.
